Posterior predictive check summaries

bayes_pp_check.Rd

Returns observed and replicated summaries. Version 0.3.0 keeps the returned replicated draws so users can construct design-specific checks rather than relying on a single generic graphic.

Usage

bayes_pp_check(fit, ndraws = 200, seed = 20260824)

Arguments

fit

A posterior-estimation `bayes_fit`.

ndraws

Number of posterior predictive draws.

seed

Random seed for the native engine.

Value

A list with observed summaries, replicated summaries, and draw matrix.

Examples

# Example 1: CRD posterior predictive check
f <- bayes_fit(bayes_crd(bayes_teaching_data("crd"), "yield", "treatment"),
               draws = 600)
ppc <- bayes_pp_check(f, ndraws = 100)
ppc$observed
#>         mean        sd minimum  maximum      q10      q90
#> 10% 6.484965 0.5355904 5.66591 7.676907 5.855358 7.127354

# Example 2: inspect replicated mean distribution
summary(ppc$replicated$mean)
#>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#>   6.278   6.401   6.460   6.471   6.525   6.892 

# Example 3: RCBD posterior predictive check
f2 <- bayes_fit(bayes_rcbd(bayes_teaching_data("rcbd"), "yield",
                "cultivar", "block"), draws = 600)
bayes_pp_check(f2, ndraws = 50)$replicated
